quotes.text: 501.    LA SEMANA PASADA, DEL……...........… AL……..…., ¿TUVO UD. ALGÚN TRABAJO? (Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar)
Los quehaceres del hogar no le permiten ............................................. 6

assessments.reasoning: The supplied survey instrument does not contain a separate module on domestic or care work. Across the supplied documentation (Chapters 100, 200, and 500), unpaid domestic work is not measured through a dedicated module containing more than two questions. Instead, domestic tasks ('quehaceres del hogar') are explicitly excluded from employment in question 501 ('Sin contar los quehaceres del hogar') and categorized as non-work activities or reasons for not seeking employment in questions 546 and 549.
